question: What was settled revenue in H1 2026?

input.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS sum_amount, SUM(o.gross_amount) AS sum_gross, SUM(o.discount_amount) AS sum_disc, SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) AS sum_net FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount = o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_match, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount <> o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id

SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS payments_with_refund, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS sum_refund, SUM(p.amount) AS sum_payment_amt FROM payments p JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id=p.payment_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status
SELECT MIN(order_date) AS min_order, MAX(order_date) AS max_order, MIN(payment_date) AS min_pay, MAX(payment_date) AS max_pay FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id

SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS settled_revenue, SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) AS check_net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS settled_payments FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE p.status='settled' AND p.payment_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

input.answer_text: Settled revenue in H1 2026 was $14,097,425.35 (2,422 settled payments). Caveat: only payments with status='settled' count, and payment amount equals gross_amount minus order-level discount, so non-settled/refunded/failed/chargeback/voided/pending payments are excluded rather than using SUM(amount) over all payments.

question: What was settled revenue in January 2026?

input.sql: SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(p.amount) AS sum_pay, SUM(o.gross_amount) AS sum_gross, SUM(o.discount_amount) AS sum_disc, SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) AS sum_net FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS by_payment_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS by_order_date,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.payment_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN 1 END) AS n_pay,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' THEN 1 END) AS n_order
FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id
WHERE p.status='settled'
SELECT MIN(payment_date) AS min_pay, MAX(payment_date) AS max_pay, MIN(o.order_date) AS min_order, MAX(o.order_date) AS max_order FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id
SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT r.payment_id) AS n_refunds, COUNT(*) AS n_payments FROM payments p LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id=p.payment_id GROUP BY p.status
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(p.amount) AS settled_sum FROM payments p WHERE p.status='settled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

input.answer_text: $2,270,505.12 in January 2026 (403 settled payments by payment_date). Only payments with status='settled' count as revenue, and payment amount is already net of order-level discounts (gross − discount), excluding pending, failed, chargeback, voided, and refunded payments.

question: What was settled revenue in Q2 2026?

input.sql: SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(p.amount) AS sum_amt, SUM(o.gross_amount) AS sum_gross, SUM(o.discount_amount) AS sum_disc, SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) AS sum_net FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND p.payment_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS settled_by_payment_date_Q2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS settled_by_order_date_Q2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND p.payment_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_by_payment_date,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.payment_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND p.payment_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_pay_Q2,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) AS cnt_order_Q2
FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.status = 'settled'
SELECT MIN(payment_date) AS min_pay, MAX(payment_date) AS max_pay, MIN(o.order_date) AS min_order, MAX(o.order_date) AS max_order FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunds_total, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_sum FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id=r.payment_id WHERE p.status='settled'
SELECT CAST((p.payment_date - o.order_date) AS INTEGER) AS lag_days, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id GROUP BY lag_days ORDER BY lag_days

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS order_month, DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date) AS pay_month, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(p.amount) AS amt FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.status='settled' GROUP BY order_month, pay_month ORDER BY order_month, pay_month

SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS settled_revenue_q2_2026, SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) AS net_revenue_check, COUNT(*) AS n_settled_payments FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'settled' AND p.payment_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND p.payment_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
